description: Terminal-Bench style ops repair: bring a drifted crontab back in line with the documented schedule policy (four jobs, exact minute/hour/weekday fields, POSIX day numbers) and restore the missing shebang that silently kills the cleanup job.

criteria: All four schedules match the spec exactly (backup daily 02:30, cleanup hourly at :15, report Sundays 03:00 with the POSIX 0 day, health every 5 minutes in business hours on weekdays) and bin/cleanup.sh starts with a shebang - verified by the gate's own cron parser, not by string luck.
